_comment: Edit these before each run. Sources: Gallup (approval), RCP/538/Silver Bulletin generic-ballot averages. Margins are Dem-minus-Rep in points.
_map_comment: map_shift_dem_seats: expected net Dem seat change from 2025-26 mid-decade redistricting vs the old maps (negative = helps GOP). As of mid-2026: TX -5, MO -1, NC -1, OH -2 vs CA +5, UT +1 => about -3. map_shift_sd is the 1-sigma uncertainty on that number (court fights, maps performing differently than drawn).
as_of: 2026-07-31 (approval ~39 per Silver Bulletin/AP-NORC; generic ballot D+6 per RCP/USPollingData/FiftyPlusOne averages)
